title: The Pokémon Christmas Gift Guide for the Whole Family
description: Pokémon Christmas gifts for the whole family, all from Sam's Club: LEGO Pokémon Eevee, LEGO Pokémon Pikachu and Poké Ball, a Pikachu body pillow, Pokémon Pokopia for Nintendo Switch 2 and the Pokémon Deluxe Character Guide.
intro: Every family has a Pokémon person. Sometimes it's the kid. Sometimes it's the dad who still knows every Kanto name by heart. This list covers all of them. Two LEGO builds for the grown-ups who want a project on Christmas afternoon, a giant Pikachu pillow for the couch, Pokopia for the Switch 2 and a big gold character guide for the one who wants to read every single entry. Wrap it. Hide it. Act surprised.

sections.heading: The builds
paragraphs: The LEGO Pokémon Eevee building set, 587 pieces, and the LEGO Pokémon Pikachu and Poké Ball set, 2050 pieces. Both are labeled 18+, so they're the grown-up gifts on this list.

sections.heading: The cozy and the game
paragraphs: The licensed character kids body pillow in Pikachu, 18 by 36 inches, and Pokémon Pokopia for Nintendo Switch 2.

sections.heading: The book
paragraphs: The Pokémon Deluxe Character Guide by Alex Irvine, hardcover.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The gaming room, the tree, the wrapping paper and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
